column1: 23242§obscene§əbˈsiːn§The obscene words in the television programs were bleeped out.§电视节目中的**粗鄙**词语已用哔声消除了。§
23243§authentic§ɔːˈθentɪk§Scientists have derived authentic data about the age of the skeleton from carbon dating tests.§科学家利用碳定年法得出了这具骨架的**准确**年代。§
23244§righteous§ˈraɪtʃəs§No matter how good and righteous one thinks his action is, he shouldn't break the law.§不管一个人认为他的行为多么友善多么**正义**，他都不应该犯法。§
23245§purify§ˈpjʊərɪfaɪ§As is well-known, one of the main doctrines of this religion is that people should try to purify their mind.§众所周知，该宗教的一条主要教义是人们要**净化**自己的心灵。§

23246§gregarious§grɪˈgeəriəs§Dr. Green, a famous zoologist at Harvard University, claimed that wild goose remains gregarious during the migration.§哈佛大学著名的动物学家格林博士称，大雁在迁徙中保持**群居**。§改例句：Harvard University 是专名，前面不加 the
23247§heartless§ˈhɑːtləs§In employees' mind, employers are cold and heartless, showing no concern for their welfare.§在员工的心目中，雇主冷酷**无情**，不关心他们的福利。§
23248§instill§ɪnˈstɪl§Trust and encouragement can instill confidence into a person, which can serve him or her well for life.§信任和鼓励能使人**逐步树立**起信心，让他们终生受益。§
23249§infringe§ɪnˈfrɪndʒ§Some students argued that the new school rule would infringe on their right to read in the morning.§一些学生争论说，这条新校规将**侵犯**他们晨读的权利。§
23250§comic§ˈkɒmɪk§Henry's accident of slipping on the banana skin brought some comic relief to this boring performance.§亨利意外踩到香蕉皮滑倒给这场沉闷的表演带来了些许**喜剧**色彩，缓和了氛围。§
23251§transplant§trænsˈplɑːnt§Every year, tens of thousands of patients are given organ transplants in developed countries.§发达国家每年有数以万计的病人接受器官**移植**。§
23252§spur§spɜː(r)§Whenever the official holidays approach, many supermarkets spur the sales by means of promotion.§每当法定假日临近，许多超市就通过促销活动来**刺激**销售。§
23253§barbaric§bɑːˈbærɪk§The animal protectors consider the idea of killing wild animals for pleasure extremely barbaric.§动物保护者认为以猎杀野生动物为乐的想法极其**野蛮**。§

23254§delinquent§dɪˈlɪŋkwənt§Recent research shows that there has been a sharp increase in the rate of juvenile delinquents related to domestic violence.§最近的一项调查显示，与家庭暴力相关的青少年**犯罪**率剧增。§改例句：research 不可数，去掉 A；delinquent 作名词是可数名词，改为复数 delinquents
23255§sluttish§ˈslʌtɪʃ§The landlord complained that the sluttish tenant had left dirty dishes and rubbish piled up in the kitchen for weeks.§房东抱怨那个**邋遢**的租客把脏碗碟和垃圾在厨房里堆了好几周。§补例句

23256§retaliate§rɪˈtælieɪt§If you look down on people and treat them badly, they'll retaliate and appear just as annoying and hostile as you expected.§如果你瞧不起别人，待他们不好，他们就会**回敬**你，就会像你预料的那样显得令人讨厌，充满敌意。§

23257§perpetrate§ˈpɜːpətreɪt§Nowadays, there is a common phenomenon in society that more and more criminals make use of new scientific technologies to perpetrate crimes.§如今，社会上出现一个普遍的现象，越来越多的犯罪分子利用新的科学技术**从事**犯罪活动。§
23258§prosper§ˈprɒspə(r)§In other words, without languages, there will be no knowledge on which a society relies to prosper.§换句话说，没有语言，就没有一个社会赖以**繁荣**的知识。§改译文：原译「生存」不是 prosper（繁荣）的意思，改为「繁荣」
23259§anchor§ˈæŋkə(r)§When a ship anchors, it means sailors can stay in the town for a short time to live as locals.§轮船**抛锚**，意味着船员们可以在小镇稍作停留，过一下当地人的生活。§
23260§despoil§dɪˈspɔɪl§If human beings continue to despoil the natural resources crazily, they will be doomed to be punished by nature.§如果人类继续疯狂地**掠夺**自然资源，他们必将遭到自然的惩罚。§
23261§discourteous§dɪsˈkɜːtiəs§It would be discourteous for young people to ignore their parents' basic request for living together.§年轻人无视父母要求住在一起的基本请求是**无礼**的。§
23262§lax§læks§Much to our surprise, some companies have been lax in carrying out their social responsibilities.§令我们大为吃惊的是，一些公司在履行其社会职责方面表现得很**懈怠**。§
23263§boost§buːst§Apparently, stock prices were boosted by the President's recovery report and supportive policies from the government.§显而易见，股票价格随着总统的经济复苏报告和政府的扶持政策而一路**上扬**。§
23264§smear§smɪə(r)§Tony explained to the police that, the blood which was smeared on the front of his car belonged to a wild cat.§托尼向警方解释说，他车头**蹭到**的血迹是一只野猫的。§
23265§lenient§ˈliːniənt§According to the recent survey, most of the job applicants prefer to work at companies whose rules and regulations are lenient.§最新调查显示，大多数求职者喜欢在规章制度**宽松**的公司工作。§
23266§synthetic§sɪnˈθetɪk§Some clothes in the market including natural fibre silk and synthetic ones could not be crushed easily.§市面上一些含天然纤维真丝和**合成**纤维的衣服不易起皱。§
23267§enact§ɪˈnækt§Under the new law, Internet bars must enact relevant policies to prevent young people's admission.§新的法律规定，网吧必须**制定**相关政策制止未成年人进入。§

23268§resent§rɪˈzent§With other audiences you mustn't attempt to cut in with humour as they will resent an outsider making disparaging remarks about their canteen or their chairman.§对于其他听众，你不能试图用幽默来打断他们的谈话，因为他们会**讨厌**一个外人对他们的餐厅或董事长发表轻蔑的评论。§

23269§affluent§ˈæfluənt§Affluent someone may be born, but he is usually uncertain of how to create an admiring life with it or cherish all he has.§有些人可能生于**富裕**之家，但却往往不知道如何利用其先天优势来创造一个令人称羡的生活或是珍惜所拥有的一切。§
23270§trunk§trʌŋk§White poplar is always eulogized by writers for its tall and straight trunk.§白杨树总因其高大笔直的**树干**备受作家们的赞美。§改译文：原译「枝干」是枝和干，trunk 是树干，改为「树干」
23271§coexist§ˌkəʊɪgˈzɪst§Many foreigners believe that traditional Chinese medicine cannot coexist with western medicine in the west.§许多外国人认为，在西方，传统的中医很难与西医**共存**。§

23272§aviation§ˌeɪviˈeɪʃn§It can be seen that Yang Liwei's travel in outer space around the earth's orbit is a milestone of China's aviation.§杨利伟在外太空绕地球轨道航行可以说是中国**航空**史上的一座里程碑。§改译文：原译「航天」不是 aviation（航空）的意思，改为「航空」
23273§rampant§ˈræmpənt§If one day inflation is rampant, it means that people's increased wage will be worth nothing soon.§如果有一天通货膨胀**泛滥**成灾，那就意味着人们增长的工资很快就会一文不值。§
23274§prolonged§prəˈlɒŋd§As the recent experiment shows, prolonged use of the new drug might have harmful side effects on patients.§最新的实验表明，**长期**使用这种新药物可能会对病人产生有害的副作用。§
23275§crushing§ˈkrʌʃɪŋ§The shipyard has been dealt another crushing blow with the failure to win this contract.§由于未能赢得这份合同，造船厂又遭到了一次**惨重**的打击。§
23276§futile§ˈfjuːtaɪl§Our attempts to improve performance are futile.§我们为提高业绩而进行的努力都**付诸东流**了。§
23277§edify§ˈedɪfaɪ§Good books not only edify but also entertain their readers.§好书不仅可以**陶冶**读者的情操，还可以娱乐读者。§
23278§vulgar§ˈvʌlgə(r)§It seems pretty vulgar to give a woman your business card in public asking for a date or dinner.§当众给女性名片要求约会或共进晚餐似乎非常**粗俗**。§
23279§core§kɔː(r)§Any profit company's core is trying to transform its product into capital.§任何营利性公司的**核心**都是要将其产品转化为资本。§
23280§inborn§ˌɪnˈbɔːn§Many sociologists claim good living habits are not inborn but can be learned by hard work.§许多社会学家声称，好的生活习惯不是**天生**的，而是可以通过努力习得的。§改例句：hard-working 是形容词，介词 by 后应为名词 hard work

23281§habitable§ˈhæbɪtəbl§Some areas of the earth are not habitable because of extreme climate conditions, such as low temperature.§地球上的一些区域由于低温之类的极端气候条件而不**适合居住**。§改译文：原译「适合人类居住」中间隔着「人类」，括不出 habitable（适于居住），删去「人类」

23282§ecological§ˌiːkəˈlɒdʒɪkl§Some scientists claim that the destruction of the rainforests is an ecological disaster that is threatening the survival of life on earth.§一些科学家声称，雨林的破坏是一场**生态**灾难，正威胁着地球上生命的生存。§

23283§stipulate§ˈstɪpjuleɪt§The new regulation stipulates that every procedure has to comply with the relevant safety production standards.§新制度**规定**每一个步骤都要遵守相关的安全生产标准。§改例句：comply 后接介词 with，comply to 用错

23284§legitimize§lɪˈdʒɪtəmaɪz§Some parents are concerned that a lot of violent films will be legitimized, which will pose a threat to their children's mental health.§一些家长担心，大量的暴力电影被**合法化**会对孩子的心理健康构成威胁。§

23285§crystallize§ˈkrɪstəlaɪz§Sometimes, what we suffered in life is not a total mess, which might help us to crystallize pieces of thoughts.§我们生活中所遭遇的并不一定完全是坏事，有时也可以帮我们**总结**出一些想法。§改例句：mess 是名词，修饰语应用形容词 total，totally 错
23286§solar-powered§ˈsəʊlə ˌpaʊəd§A solar-powered battery can transform the energy of sunlight into electric energy.§**太阳能**电池能把光能转化为电能。§改例句：单数可数名词 battery 前缺冠词，补 A

23287§cosy§ˈkəʊzi§Learning in a warm and cosy classroom is the best dream these children in impoverished mountainous districts have wished.§能够在温暖**舒适**的教室里学习是贫困山区孩子们最大的愿望。§改例句：district 是可数名词，单数不能直接用，改为复数 districts

23288§roller§ˈrəʊlə(r)§The huge roller can press melted metal into thin sheets which are the raw material of knives.§大型**滚筒**可以将熔化的金属压成薄片，作为刀具的原材料。§改例句：sheet、knife 是可数名词，单数不能直接用，改为复数 sheets、knives（is 随之改 are）

23289§unsanitary§ʌnˈsænətri§Lack of access to safe water, poor housing, and unsanitary conditions all have a strong bearing on the health of the mother and child.§缺乏安全用水、住房条件差以及**不卫生**的环境都对母亲和儿童的健康有很大的影响。§
23290§condone§kənˈdəʊn§If the government condones violent conflict between the two parties, the bloodshed will never stop.§如果政府**纵容**两党之间的暴力冲突，流血事件将永远不会停止。§改译文：原译「无视」不是 condone（纵容，容忍）的意思，改为「纵容」
23291§bereave§bɪˈriːv§Nobody can bereave wild animals and plants of their survival on the blue planet where we live together.§没人能够**剥夺**野生动植物在我们共有的蓝色星球上生存的权利。§

23292§faulty§ˈfɔːlti§In addition to faulty brakes, this terrible accident which has caused 3 dead and 1 injured, was attributed to drunk driving.§除了刹车**有问题**之外，酒后驾车也是导致这起三死一伤严重事故的原因。§改例句：brake 是可数名词，单数不能直接用，改为复数 brakes
23293§enigma§ɪˈnɪgmə§Up to now, researchers and scientists cannot explain the whole enigma of Mayan civilization's disappearance.§研究者和科学家至今都无法解释玛雅文明消失这个**谜团**。§
23294§spare§speə(r)§Thank you very much for sparing so much of your time to talk with me.§非常感谢您**抽出**这么长的时间与我谈话。§
23295§nursery§ˈnɜːsəri§Whether the state should provide free nursery education or not is being discussed on the table.§国家是否应该提供免费的**幼儿**教育这一问题正在讨论之中。§
23296§semantic§sɪˈmæntɪk§It is well-known that the professor is expert in language teaching and semantic analysis.§众所周知，该教授擅长语言教学和**语义**分析。§
23297§barren§ˈbærən§Geographers made great efforts to find that millions of years ago the region was a barren desert.§地理学家经过极大的努力发现，数百万年前该地区是一片**荒芜**的沙漠。§
23298§conductive§kənˈdʌktɪv§Scientists found that this kind of new material was more conductive at extremely low temperature than at the ordinary temperature.§科学家发现，这种新材料在极端的低温条件下比在常温下**导电**性更好。§
23299§eccentric§ɪkˈsentrɪk§Psychologists are trying to find the reason why some children cultivate eccentric behaviour to separate themselves from their peers.§心理学家正致力于为一些孩子远离同伴孤立自己的**古怪**行为找出原因。§
23300§inferior§ɪnˈfɪəriə(r)§In general, schooling in suburbs is inferior to that in downtown, interior regions to coastal ones.§一般而言，城郊的学校教育**不如**市中心的，内陆的不如沿海的。§
23301§slacken§ˈslækən§The pace of export and import slackened during the last quarter due to trade barrier between the two countries.§由于两国间的贸易壁垒，进出口步伐在上一季度有所**放缓**。§
23302§mentor§ˈmentɔː(r)§Every great leader who has created great achievement has a mentor, who can advise, help and point him to success.§每一个创造了巨大成就的伟大领袖都有一个能够给他建议、帮助他并指引他走向成功的**导师**。§
23303§pad§pæd§The secretary always puts a pad by the telephone for taking notes.§秘书总是在电话机旁放一个**便笺本**以便做记录。§改例句：单数可数名词 secretary 前缺冠词，补 The

23304§unblemished§ʌnˈblemɪʃt§Some states indicated that, it would be legal to get a remission if a prisoner in jail keeps an unblemished record in three years.§一些州政府表示，如果服刑期的囚犯三年内记录**清白**，就可以合法获得减刑。§改译文：原译「没有任何不良记录」是否定说法，括不出 unblemished（无瑕疵的），改为「记录清白」
23305§lounge§laʊndʒ§Some students were used to lounging in the dormitory to surf on the Internet at the weekends.§一些学生习惯于周末待在宿舍，**懒洋洋地坐着**，在网上冲浪。§
23306§dietary§ˈdaɪətəri§For tourists with special dietary requirements, we will offer a variety of delicious food for them to choose.§对于有特殊**饮食**要求的游客，我们会提供各种美食供其选择。§
23307§hamper§ˈhæmpə(r)§Fierce storms have been hampering rescue work and there is now little chance of finding more survivors.§猛烈的暴风雨**阻碍**了救援工作，现在找到更多幸存者的机会已经很小了。§

23308§disparage§dɪˈspærɪdʒ§The charitable work, which public figures, especially actors and singers have done, has been disparaged by the press as an attempt to get publicity.§公众人物，尤其是演员和歌手，所做的慈善工作被媒体**贬抑**为自我宣传。§
23309§corporal§ˈkɔːpərəl§Some claim that teachers have no rights to treat naughty students with corporal punishment, while others hold an opposite opinion.§一些人声称教师无权**体**罚顽皮的学生，而另一些人持相反观点。§

23310§libel§ˈlaɪbl§Recently, that movie star is determined to sue the mass media for their libels, while he chose to keep silent in the past.§最近，那位电影明星决定指控大众媒体**诽谤**，而在过去他选择保持沉默。§改译文：原译「损害其名誉」是释义式说法，括出来是整个短语，改为 libel 的本义「诽谤」
23311§criterion§kraɪˈtɪəriən§Success in studying at school is not an appropriate criterion of achievement in life.§在学校里学习好并不是衡量人生成就的一个恰当的**标准**。§

23312§eco-friendly§ˌiːkəʊ ˈfrendli§The reusable bag is an eco-friendly product which was famous for its slogan "I am not a plastic bag!"§可再利用袋是一种**环保**产品，它曾以“我不是塑料袋”的标语而闻名。§改例句：单数可数名词 bag 前缺冠词，补 The；中文引号改为英文引号
